talk.note: 9:16 window on a 1920x1080 frame is 607.5px; 608 keeps it even. 0.09% aspect error.
talk.zoomNote: zoom:true crops 880 of the 1080 source height from the TOP. MEASURED, not guessed: V3's chapter lower-third occupies rows 888-978 on every tip's opening shot, so any crop taller than 888 leaves it half-visible under our captions. 496x880 is 9:16 to within 0.2%. The framing has the headroom to spare - the presenter's head starts around row 137.

card.note: Whole 16:9 frame, nothing cropped. Enlarged from the J2 spec's 968-wide. Sits at y=420 rather than centred because the caption band (ASS MarginV 690) starts around y=1150 — a centred card ran underneath it.

pip.note: Graphic repositioned into the top of the vertical frame; Dan below. danW is 800 (not full width) ON PURPOSE: Dan's crop must start to the RIGHT of the PiP box or the poster appears a second time inside his block, and a narrower block is the only way to do that while keeping his face near centre.
